text:
Aisha (marketing): quick sync — aiming to publish the Redwood Optimize v2 announcement next Tue 9:00am PT. need final changelog link, docs quickstart, and a confirmed rollout window from eng so we can time the blog + webinar CTA.
Tom (engineering): can do. propose canary at 6:00am PT, ramp to 10% at 7:00, 50% at 8:00, full by 9:30 if health checks pass. any constraints from marketing side?
Aisha (marketing): marketing plan is public blog at 9:00, social and small organic posts at 9:05, and the webinar CTA live at 9:30. we prefer the public blog to go live when prod is at least partially ramped (>=50%).
Jordan (docs): docs PR ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr/482 — changelog draft in the top. adding migration steps and sample config for the new cache params today.
Riley (devex): webinar set for 10:00am PT with Heather. landing page draft: https://redwood.ai/webinar/optimize-v2-preview — need three concise benchmark bullets for the hero.
Tom (engineering): benchmark bullets draft: 
```
- ~2x faster handling of long-context multi-turn sessions compared to v1
- up to 20% lower per-token cost via dynamic batching + KV prefix caching
- 95th pct tail latency remains <120ms on 32k context tests
```
Aisha (marketing): nice. tweak the first one to be audience-friendly: "faster long conversations for chat apps". also request a one-sentence plain-English explainer for the blog.
Tom (engineering): ok: "faster long conversations for chat apps (~2x speedups on long contexts)". plain-English explainer: "Optimize v2 reduces cost and keeps latency low by batching similar requests and reusing cached context."
Jordan (docs): pulling both into the changelog and the quickstart examples now. will add redirect for the old optimize guide.
InfraBot: deploy window reserved: staging canary @ 2026-04-01T06:00:00Z, prod rollout start @ 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z. rollback thresholds: 5xx > 5% sustained for 5m triggers rollback.
Ops Oncall: i'll watch dashboards during the rollout. if we see error or latency spikes, i'll coordinate rollback and message here.
Aisha (marketing): final marketing asks: please post the merged changelog URL and the docs quickstart link in this thread once they're live. also, engineering — ask that we avoid large marketing blasts until 9:15 to let autoscaling and warm pools settle.
Tom (engineering): noted. we request organic posts only before 9:15. bulk emails or paid promos should wait until after 9:15.
Riley (devex): demo script ready. will circulate to the list and add the webinar CTA on the landing page once the blog is live.
Jordan (docs): merged — changelog URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/optimize-v2 . quickstart: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/optimize-v2 . added sample config and migration notes.
Aisha (marketing): great — marketing will send embargoed blog + social drafts to the approvals list by EOD. day-of runbook items:
- engineering: monitor canary + publish final merge note here (you)
- docs: verify redirects + sample config (you)
- devex: webinar landing + demo script (you)
- marketing: publish blog at 9:00, hold major blasts until 9:15 (me)
Tom (engineering): all set from infra. we'll post status updates here during the 6-9:30 window.
Aisha (marketing): thanks team — i'll consolidate a short runbook and post it tomorrow morning. please flag any blockers now. :rocket:
